notes.1: Opening aspiration formula (P1) leads into the first descriptive stanza of Mahākāla, ending with petition 'སྲུང་བར་མཛོད' (P6).
notes.7: Two-line unit describing eyes/face, ending with petition 'ཞིང་སྐྱོང་མཛོད' (P8).
notes.9: Four-line stanza describing arms, implements, ending with petition 'ཞིང་སྐྱོང་ཁྱོད་ཀྱིས་སྲུངས' (P12).
notes.13: Four-line stanza describing terrifying form and ornament, ending with finite verb 'ཞལ་དུ་གསོལ' (P16).
notes.17: Four-line stanza describing subjugation of spirits and consuming blood, ending with petition 'སྲུང་བར་མཛད' (P20).
notes.21: Three-line unit of wrathful appearance in fire, ending with petition/simile at P23.
notes.24: Three-line unit with syllables tsaṃ, kriṃ, saṃ, ending with petition 'ཁྱོད་ཀྱིས་སྐྱོངས' (P26).
notes.27: Six-line stanza of syllables baṃ, yaṃ, klaṃ, paṃ concluding the eight-verse praise with final petition 'ཡུན་རིང་བསྐྱང་དུ་གསོལ' (P32).
notes.33: Four-line phan yon (benefits of recitation) concluding the verse treatise.
notes.38: Translator colophon lead-in line preceding section heading.
